founderAuthorization.rule: [PKG-R] Paketleme paketi + reseal yetkisi: yeni protected release-packaging paketi (SHA256SUMS üreticisi, deterministik ZIP, mevcut verify-artifact ile fresh-extract doğrulaması) ve bu paket içinde maintainer-only generate-trust-root.mjs final reseal'ini çalıştırma yetkisi; release imzası Founder'ın harici anahtarında kalır; Codex review otomatik. [Mühürlü mod] paste4d'ye açık ve fail-closed bir SEALED modu eklenir. Mod yalnız manifest SEALED iken devreye girer; trust root ve SHA256SUMS o anda yeniden doğrulanır, doğrulamadan geçmeyen FAIL olur. İmza artifact dışında (detached) kalır. Phase0=PENDING ve SOURCE_LEVEL_CLOSURE=false zorunlu kalır. paste4c ve belgeler PASS demeyen release-candidate değerleri alır (SEALED_RELEASE_CANDIDATE, EXTERNAL_DETACHED_SIGNATURE_REQUIRED). Mühürlü durum review edilmiş bir commit olur ve ZIP tam o commit'ten üretilir. Adversarial testler eklenir, Codex review otomatik yapılır.
founderAuthorization.constraint: Minimum changes only; no weakening of trust, authority, reviewer isolation, evidence, provenance, Global Stop, security or fail-closed behavior; UNKNOWN, NOT_TESTED, BLOCKED or FAIL are never converted to PASS/CLEAN without real evidence; broader protected changes require separate Founder approval.

reseal.runAfter: every protected-file edit of this commit (CANONICAL-STATUS.md) and with no untracked or ignored files under protected prefixes
reseal.verification: scripts/verify-trust-root.mjs PASS on the working tree; paste4d SEALED mode re-verifies it in-process during canonical validation
reseal.consequence: Any later change to a protected file breaks the seal and needs a new reseal and review before packaging.

order: final trust-root reseal (this commit) -> git archive export of exactly this commit -> scripts/release-sha256sums.mjs -> scripts/build-release-zip.mjs -> scripts/verify-release-extract.mjs --with-validation -> Founder detached signature over the verified ZIP and SHA256SUMS.txt -> scripts/install.ps1 Phase0 on a fresh extract of the signed ZIP. The signature follows the ZIP because it is made over the ZIP file.
